text: Staff from the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit will give a presentation that provides an overview of the process to develop a Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee workplan, issues and desired impacts to be considered and advanced during the Committee's term and key considerations to inform forthcoming meeting agendas.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee adopted the 2024-2026 Work Plan taking into account the suggestions made by members of the Committee at the meeting.
